segments.raw_interview_anchor: Immediate modified plyometrics, holding, or reduced-intensity work were considered; holding was selected.

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Full clearance, structured reconditioning, or another screen were considered; full clearance was chosen.

segments.raw_interview_anchor: The re-injury answer used only patient thresholds and omitted general re-injury frequency for pivoting-sport athletes.
